 "rationale": "A sub-1V reference needs current-mode summing. Any Veb+PTAT sum near 0.66 V would drift about -1.8 mV/C. PTAT current is UT*ln8/R1 and CTAT current is Veb/R3. R3/R1 of about 10.6 cancels the slopes, and R4 scales Vref to 0.66 V. Each of the 3 branches carries about 0.53 uA, and the startup pull-up draws about 0.1 uA, giving about 1.7 uA (3.1 uW). Long-L PMOS and a vdd-pg capacitor give the PSRR and line regulation."}

PARAMS = {
    "R1":  (216e3, 150e3, 320e3),   # PTAT resistor
    "R3":  (2.3e6, 1.6e6, 3.2e6),   # CTAT shunt resistors (one per emitter node)
    "R4":  (1.25e6, 1.0e6, 1.5e6),  # output resistor -> sets Vref
    "Wp":  (20.0, 8.0, 40.0),       # PMOS mirror W (deep subthreshold, low Vsg)
    "Lp":  (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),         # PMOS mirror L (high ro for PSRR / line reg)
    "Wn":  (10.0, 4.0, 20.0),       # NMOS level-shift pair W
    "Ln":  (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),         # NMOS pair L
    "Cdd": (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 5e-12), # vdd-pg cap: keeps Vsg constant at AC
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8          # PNP area ratio Q2:Q1 (m=16 : m=2)
    m1 = 2
    R1, R3, R4 = p["R1"], p["R3"], p["R4"]
    Wp, Lp, Wn, Ln = p["Wp"], p["Lp"], p["Wn"], p["Ln"]

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")

    # ---- PMOS mirror (MP2 diode on node pg) ----
    n.M("MP1", "ng",   "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("MP2", "pg",   "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("MP3", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)

    # ---- NMOS level-shift pair: forces V(A) = V(B) ----
    n.M("MN1", "ng", "ng", "a", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)   # diode, Q1 side
    n.M("MN2", "pg", "ng", "b", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)   # degenerated side

    # ---- PNPs + PTAT resistor ----
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "a", m=m1)
    n.R("R1", "b", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=m1 * N)

    # ---- CTAT shunt resistors (Banba current-mode) ----
    n.R("R3a", "a", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R3b", "b", "vss", R3)

    # ---- output ----
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    n.C("Cdd", "vdd", "pg", p["Cdd"])

    # ---- start-up: st high when core off (ng low) -> pull pg down ----
    n.M("MS1a", "s1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS1b", "s2", "vss", "s1",  "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS1c", "st", "vss", "s2",  "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS2",  "st", "ng",  "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS3",  "pg", "st",  "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    Iptat = UT * math.log(N) / R1
    Veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / (Iptat / m1))
    Ictat = Veb / R3
    Ib = Iptat + Ictat
    vref = R4 * Ib
    # TC: dVref/dT = R4*(Iptat/T + dVeb/dT / R3), dVeb/dT ~ -(1.2-Veb)/300 - 3k/q
    dveb = -(1.2 - Veb) / 300.0 - 3 * 8.617e-5
    dvdt = R4 * (Iptat / 300.0 + dveb / R3)
    curv = 0.004   # residual Veb curvature over the box (V)
    tc = (abs(dvdt) * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    Istart = 0.1e-6
    power = 1.8 * (3 * Ib + Istart)
    # line reg: output PMOS ro (approx VA ~ 20 V/um * Lp)
    ro = (20.0 * Lp) / Ib
    line_reg = R4 / ro + 0.3 * R4 / ro   # + core channel-length modulation share
    psrr = -20 * math.log10(max(line_reg, 1e-6))
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line_reg, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
